pr_title: fix: making api tokens creation work
pr_body:
### What does it do?

- Makes sure that the lifespan is a number not a string
- Makes sure the user gets navigated to the correct page after successful creation
- Add e2e tests to for creating API tokens

### Why is it needed?

- Creating API tokens was broken

### How to test it?

- Attempt to create an API token, it should work and you should be able to copy the token

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

fix #19994

issue_context.title: API Token creation not working (due to token-duration)
issue_context.body:
## Bug report
API Token creation is not working at the moment.

### Required System information

- Node.js version: v18.17.0
- Strapi version: 5.0.0-beta.1
- Database: sqllite
- Is your project Javascript or Typescript: JS
Environment: development
OS: darwin-arm64
Node/Yarn Version: yarn/1.22.19 npm/? node/v18.17.0 darwin arm64
Edition: Community

### Describe the bug

In the process of testing the v5-beta within my given architecture, I was not able to create an API token due to errors in the token-duration setting field. No matter what I choose from the dropdown, I'll always run into getting an error like: "lifespan must be one of the following values: , 604800000, 2592000000, 7776000000". I can't set this manually and I can't proceed to create the token in any form.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Install the beta with npx create-strapi-app@beta beta --quickstart
2. Create admin user and proceed to the "General Settings > API Token" section
3. Try to create a token with ANY token type or token duration and you'll run into an error in the token-duration field

### Expected behavior

Creation of the Token with correct duration settings

### Screenshots

![screenshot 2024-04-02 at 17 17 30](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/assets/23657676/19713475-cffb-4776-94bf-1675905ff04a)
